pointer-free-notation.definition: Byrne's 1847 replacement of arbitrary alphabetic vertex pointers (A, B, C) by colored inline shape tokens whose perceptual signature directly denotes the geometric object.

congruence-twin.definition: Byrne's deliberate assignment of the identical color/stroke register to two distinct symmetric elements known or proved equal (such as the two red legs of an isosceles triangle in I.5).

register-pressure.definition: When a proposition contains more than four primitives of the same geometric sort (e.g. five pentagon sides in IV.11), requiring stroke modulation (dashed, dotted, solid-dotted) to preserve uniqueness.

extreme-and-mean-ratio.headword: Extreme and Mean Ratio (ἄκρος καὶ μέσος λόγος)
extreme-and-mean-ratio.definition: Division of a segment AB at H so that AB : AH :: AH : HB (Book VI Def. 3, VI.30), constructed purely by colored area algebra without proportion theory in Book II Prop. 11.

gnomon.definition: In Book II Def. 2 and Props. 4–8, either of the two complements about the diagonal of a parallelogram together with either of the parallelograms about the diameter.

alternando.definition: Transformation of A : B :: C : D into A : C :: B : D for four homogeneous magnitudes, expressed by Byrne with colored circle, square, diamond, and shield glyphs.

ekthesis.definition: Second Proclean division of a proposition, instantiating the general enunciation upon the concrete colored diagram.

apodeixis.definition: Fifth Proclean division of a proposition, formatted by Byrne as a vertical sequence of symbolic equations with marginal axiom/proposition citations.
